history.title: A reconstructed history
history.caveat: No source tells this life: every particular of it is ours.
paragraphs: He was born about 1826 in County Donegal, Ireland and came to Chicago about 1846. He works as a cooper, and the household lives in the city's outer streets. The family's church is Holy Family.
